purpose: Operational review requirements, not preapproved scientific content

acceptance_standard.user_priority: Qualify EDA first, then apply equivalent operational precision across all stages.
hard_gates: Original evidence supports scientific claims with exact locators and applicability; citation existence alone fails.
Field definitions, units, basis, window, independent unit and joins explicit.
Operational sequence and outputs sufficient without invented scientific choices.
Censoring, missing inputs, uncertainty, stop and partial fallback explicit.
Scientific inference separate from engineering convention and project overlay.
Positive and adversarial worked examples pass; actual output inspected.
No critical scientific error; no compensating average score.

other_stage_equivalents.animal_pk: estimand, inputs, method applicability, diagnostics, nonidentifiability and outputs
other_stage_equivalents.pkpd: exposure/response linkage, endpoint reference, model/target scope and uncertainty
other_stage_equivalents.translation: species/parameter bridge, formula, unit/binding basis, domain and extrapolation uncertainty
other_stage_equivalents.human_simulation: scenario inputs, population vs parameter uncertainty, correlations and interpretation
other_stage_equivalents.pta: target/window/basis, distribution, denominator, weights and boundary handling

acceptance_standard.promotion_rule: EDA exemplar must pass semantic and operational probes before standard is promoted. All other cards remain pending until individually reviewed.
scope_limitations: Eight selected EDA methods and controlled synthetic scenarios only.
Plot probes are reviewer-implemented from recipes, not an end-to-end blind benchmark of arbitrary AI code generation.
Remaining stage cards require individual semantic/operational review; legacy 24-query presence is not general translational workflow adequacy.
Source-specific drug examples remain bounded; target-specific human data absent.
Scientific approval and production activation not granted.

note: Positive and adversarial synthetic examples must be independently checked after generation. No actual fitting, target-drug parameters or clinical claims.
